# Production Knowledge Templates

Use these to create atomic operational knowledge files under `doc/prod/`.

| Knowledge | Target |
|---|---|
| Known bug | `doc/prod/known-bugs/BUG-<id>-<slug>.md` |
| Structural risk | `doc/prod/structural-risks/RISK-<id>-<slug>.md` |
| Root-cause playbook | `doc/prod/root-cause-playbooks/PLAYBOOK-<slug>.md` |
| Watchlist item | `doc/prod/watchlist/WATCH-<slug>.md` |
| Incident | `doc/prod/incidents/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/ANALYSIS.md` |
